description: Java entity class representing a KYC (Know Your Customer) record in the domain package, using JPA annotations for ORM mapping. It includes fields for UUID id, passenger reference, Aadhaar reference, status, creation and update timestamps, along with lifecycle callbacks.

classes.name: KycRecord
classes.description: A JPA entity representing a KYC record tied to a Passenger, with fields for identification, status, timestamps, and Aadhaar reference.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to initialize id, createdAt, updatedAt, and status fields before persisting to database.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the UUID id of the KYC record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the UUID id of the KYC record.

methods.name: setPassenger
methods.description: Associates a Passenger object with this KYC record.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the KYC process.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of the KYC process.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the record was created.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last update.
